contentText: Talks are set to take place today between Danish and US officials over the future of Greenland, following remarks by Donald Trump suggesting the Danish territory should become part of the United States. Danish Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen and his Greenlandic counterpart, Vivian Motzfeldt, are traveling to the US for meetings with Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio. For more on this, I’m joined by our International affairs editor, Philip Turle.
